reviews.x: I was looking for a light weight inexpensive cap. This looked about like the others I have had for 3+ years now. Its the same size as any other standard one. Its has a Velcro neck. It washes just fine. The negative star is for the fact that the Velcro snags the cap occasionally. This one probably wont last as long as the last, but the last was $15 dollars, and from a supply store. Since this was less then half the price its still great.

I gave this 4 stars because the neck is very small.  It is not big enough to wrap around my husbands neck, so I use a clothes pin to close it up.  I do love that it keeps the hair off of the one getting his hair cut.  It is long enough to cover all the clothing while I cut their hair.  I thought about buying one for me, too.  When I am through, I just shake off the hair onto the ground and fold it up and store with the clippers.

Nice caps, has a velcro and a tie for the back. Fits children to large adults well.  Thin and not heavy but perfect to keep hair off clients and family.  Get 2, 1 for client and 1 for yourself, to keep tiny hairs from sticking all over yourself!

reviews.t: Works for kids! Sturdy and great quality
reviews.x: I have used this cape several times to cut my boys' hair. My youngest is not even 2 so I was worried the cape wouldn't work for him, but it worked great! It has a little Velcro closure at the top as well as some ties, so you can chose which one you would like to use based on neck size. The cape feels sturdy and doesn't feel cheap at all. I look forward to using this for a long time!

Ordered cape in February and knew it would take some time to arrive but by April contacted World Pride.  Their response was quick and cordial.  They immediately resent another cape and it arrived within a week.  It has been awhile since I have had great customer service.  Cape was just what we needed for the price.

Not enough velcro tabs to hold cape securely around neck. If person has a large neck it would fit secure however for a small framed person, the cape doesn't fit snug. I didn't return because I am able to secure with hair clips.

reviews.t: so that's good? Its large and not salon grade by any ...
reviews.x: Took a long while to receive (2 weeks), but it did come 1 day before they predicted, so that's good?  Its large and not salon grade by any means, but its exactly what I needed it to be.

reviews.t: The Velcro fell off after about a month and a ...
reviews.x: The Velcro fell off after about a month and a half of use and now, a few months in, the strings you use to tie it together are pulling off the body of the cape.

reviews.t: Cheaper than I expected. The two sides of the ...
reviews.x: Cheaper than I expected. The two sides of the Velcro are each smaller than a dime, leaving no way to adjust the fit. It is not very wide.

This is a quality cape. My mother likes when I use it when I trim her hair she says it has that barber /salon feel. The fabric is about medium weight, not to light or heavy and even has a clip to hold it close behind the neck . And you can throw it in the washer without a problem.

reviews.t: Shipping was pretty slow. But once I did receive the cape
reviews.x: Shipping was pretty slow. But once I did receive the cape. It was as I expected. Ive had it a little over 2 months now and have used it twice. The velcro that secures around the neck is very small. Not good for my husband's large neck. But works well for my kids.

reviews.t: It’s backless so hair gets on you.
reviews.x: The material is stiff. I’ve tried scrunching it into a ball, hung in shower to try to get it to loosen up but nothing works. I cut my own hair & wanted the material to hang in sink but the hair falls on floor.

reviews.t: velco scratches and pokes my neck
reviews.x: it does its job but the velcro on the cape is very itchy and stiff. it pokes my neck all the time. i have to add a tissue or a piece of fabric in between my neck and the velcro so it wont scratch or poke me
It does not snap neither does it has velcro. It has strands for you to tie together. I don’t have time for that especially working in a salon.
Do not purchase unless you want a paper thin cape:((  i thought I would use these for cutting hair instead will use for makeup Application.

reviews.t: I put it on like a cape and chase my wife around the house ...
reviews.x: It's a dandy.  I put it on like a cape and chase my wife around the house as Black Bart.  She laughs and pretends like she likes me
Took weeks to arrive. Very tiny piece of velcro to fasten around the neck. Must be a use once and throw away.  Don't buy it.

reviews.t: This cape is perfect, light weight with tie and velcro
reviews.x: This cape is perfect, light weight with tie and velcro.  best of all, if you misplace it, didn't cost and arm and a leg!

reviews.t: World Pride Salon Hair Styling Hair Cutting Cape
reviews.x: I am happy with this inexpensive hair styling cape.  The quality is better than expected, and very roomy.

This product was as expected, simple and effective. I was able to find from the seller for the best price, as much as six dollars less than other sellers. The only feature I wish was included was a "snap" closure for the neck line, instead, this is just two ribbons which required to be tied together. As far as doing the job, it functions very well, it's lightweight and folds down to a very compact size for storage – I'm able to keep it within the container that holds my hair clippers and attachm

Save your money. This is so ridiculously lightweight and low quality. It doesn’t cover well at all, and it would not stay around my shoulders. By the end of coloring my hair, this thing was no longer covering my shoulders at all and was all bunched up on the front of my body. Seriously, no coverage. I figured this was a pretty simple product. Pretty hard to screw this up, right? Wrong. This manufacturer definitely managed it in spectacular fashion.

I bought this because it was so inexpensive and had 4 stars, but this isn't any better than using a garbage bag.  The neck fastener is velcro and only allows for one size, so hair gets down the neck of anyone with a smaller neck than the pre-set size, which would be any kids.  Having said that, I need to give it at least 2 stars for the price...

reviews.t: Personally I like it. Does the job rite
reviews.x: Personally I like it. Does the job rite, and the price it's great. At the beginning I was doughting to get it because it uses velcro and not the clips. But it holds perfect and does not loosen. Even though it's cheaper than others quality it's good. And the hair slides rite off.

reviews.t: You Get What You Pay For.
reviews.x: This does exactly what I want it to do (make clean up easier after cutting my husbands hair), but it's kind of thin. I assume it'll last a while, but it won't last forever. If you're looking for something durable to use in your business, this probably won't work for you.

I purchased this s cape for hair cuts to replace a very old one. When I first saw the package, I was concerned due to size. But this is a full size cape that will work well for both clipper and scissor cuts. It is a fine lightweight material.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the cape works well and fits a range of people, including children and large adults.
The Velcro neck closure is a common complaint: it is too small for larger necks and too loose for smaller ones.
Some reviewers report the Velcro is itchy, stiff, or snags the cape, and a few say it fell off or the ties pulled away over time.
Several reviewers describe the material as thin, stiff, or cheap-feeling rather than salon grade.
Shipping was slow for some buyers, though customer service was praised for quickly resending a missing order.
